messages.subject: detectionHistory problem
parts:
Hi Jurgen,

I'm trying to generate species detection histories for the different stations. Unfortunately when I ran this the output always show the entire data set and not the stations I've chosen. 
Here I'm following the script from the vignette and using StationA as the example. Please have a look at it and help me identify the problem. Thanks. 

station.a <- recordTableSample[recordTableSample$Station == "StationA", ]
DetHist1 <- detectionHistory(recordTable         = station.a,
                            camOp                = camop_no_problem,
                            stationCol           = "Station",
                            speciesCol           = "Species",
                            recordDateTimeCol    = "DateTimeOriginal",
                            species              = "PBE",
    timeZone             = "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur",                                                                                                                    occasionLength       = 1,
                            day1                 = "2015-05-11",
                            includeEffort        = TRUE,
    scaleEffort          = FALSE)

dh <- DetHist1$detection_history[1,]
View(dh)

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: detectionHistory problem
parts:
Hi,
the detection history function combines two data sources:
- the record table, with record date, time, ID, and location
- the camera operation matrix which contains information about what cameras were used,

but you only subsetted one of them.

By subsetting the record table you basically say there were no more records, but the information about what stations were available (the camera operation matrix) remains unchanged.
What you need to do here is subset the camera operation table too, e.g.

camop_no_problem[rownames(camop_no_problem) == "StationA",]
